name: Sahil Rathod
intro: I build the interface. Connect the logic. Care about everything in between.
bio: I’m Sahil, a full stack developer based in Rajkot, India. I work with Angular, .NET and SQL to make complex applications clearer, more reliable and easier to maintain.

At Multiicon Ideotechnology, I contribute to Bonton Holidays across its Angular frontend and .NET backend. My work includes refactoring legacy code, improving form validation, aligning API contracts and debugging production issues.
Before software, I led a four-person customer support team. That experience still shapes how I build: listen carefully, understand the problem and make the next step easier for someone else.

experience.body: Contributing to Bonton Holidays across Angular and .NET/C#. Refactoring legacy components and APIs, improving state and form validation, aligning API contracts and resolving production issues.

Built Angular components, directives and services; integrated REST APIs and managed reactive state with RxJS. Also worked with SQL queries, stored procedures, transactions and basic .NET API controllers.
Led four service representatives, trained team members, managed customer complaints and developed support procedures and monthly reports.
